ura_scope_target.name: ura_scope_target
ura_scope_target.value:
("user_role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'GLOBAL' AND "user_role_assignments"."division_id" IS NULL AND "user_role_assignments"."bdl_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("user_role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'DIVISION' AND "user_role_assignments"."division_id" IS NOT NULL AND "user_role_assignments"."bdl_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("user_role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'BDL' AND "user_role_assignments"."bdl_id" IS NOT NULL AND "user_role_assignments"."division_id" IS NULL)

document_versions_has_content.name: document_versions_has_content
document_versions_has_content.value: "document_versions"."content_json" IS NOT NULL OR "document_versions"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL
